0.8 = 0.25 + x

x = 0.55

Probability of passing Science = 0.55.

questions.question: If a + b + c = 5 and a² + b² + c² = 27, find the value of a(b²+c²) + b(c² + a²) + c(a² + b²) + 3abc.
questions.questionHtml: If a + b + c = 5 and a² + b² + c² = 27, find the value of a(b²+c²) + b(c² + a²) + c(a² + b²) + 3abc.
questions.solution:
Method-1

a(b² + c²) + b(c² + a²) + c(a² + b²) + 3abc

First,

a(b² + c²) + b(c² + a²) + c(a² + b²)
= ab² + ac² + bc² + ba² + ca² + cb²

= a²b + ab² + b²c + bc² + c²a + ca²

Now add 3abc

= a²b + ab² + b²c + bc² + c²a + ca² + 3abc

= (a + b + c)(ab + bc + ca)

Now find ab + bc + ca

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

5² = 27 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

25 = 27 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

ab + bc + ca = −1

Therefore

(a + b + c)(ab + bc + ca)

= 5 × (−1) = −5

Method-2 (Value putting)

Take a = 5, b = 1, c = −1

a(b²+c²)+b(c²+a²)+c(a²+b²)+3abc

= 5(1+1) + 1(1+25) + (−1)(25+1) + 3(5×1×−1)

= 10 + 26 − 26 − 15

= −5

questions.solution:
Option C: Momentum

Explanation:

Impulse is defined as the product of Force × Time.
Impulse = F · t

Dimensions of Force: [MLT⁻²]

Multiply by Time ([T]):
[MLT⁻²] · [T] = [MLT⁻¹]

This is exactly the dimension of Momentum (p = m · v).
